label: Facebook and Instagram
what: Posts and their numbers for a Facebook Page you manage and its linked Instagram professional account.

credentials.label: App ID
credentials.help: From your app at developers.facebook.com: Settings, then Basic.

credentials.label: App secret
credentials.help: Same page: press Show next to App secret. It stays in your Keychain and is used only to sign in.

credentials.label: Page access token
credentials.help: Filled in for you by Connect with Facebook. Paste one only if you made it by hand.
credentials.looks: A very long string of letters and numbers, often starting with EAA

credentials.label: Facebook Page id
credentials.help: Filled in for you by Connect with Facebook.

credentials.label: Instagram account id
credentials.help: Filled in for you by Connect with Facebook when the Page has an Instagram account. Leave it empty to skip Instagram.

reads: Your latest Page posts with reactions, comments, shares and impressions.
Your latest Instagram posts with likes, comments and reach, if you entered the Instagram id.
not_reads: Private messages and the comment text.
Personal profiles. No API reaches them, and the token only covers the Page.
steps: You need a Facebook Page you manage. For Instagram you also need an Instagram Business or Creator account linked to that Page.
At developers.facebook.com press My Apps, then Create App. Keep it in development mode with you as the admin. You do not need to publish it.
In the app add the product Facebook Login. Under its Settings, Valid OAuth Redirect URIs, add http://localhost:53172/ and save.
In the app press Settings, then Basic. Copy the App ID and the App secret (press Show) into the two fields on this card.
Press Save all. Quarterdeck then opens Facebook. Choose your Page when it asks and approve the read-only access.
Quarterdeck gets the Page token, the Page id and the Instagram id by itself and keeps them in your Keychain. Nothing to copy.
revoke: On Facebook, open Settings, then Business Integrations, find your app and remove it. Then remove the fields here. You can also delete the app at developers.facebook.com.
tested: Parsing tested against sample data only; not tested against the real service.
